Yinlin

Yinlin (Chinese: 吟霖) is a playable Electro Congenital Resonator in Wuthering Waves. Once an outstanding Patroller who was suspended from her duties at the Public Security Bureau, Yinlin now pursues hidden evils in secrecy.
